description: Voies cyclables de la Communauté de Communes Vallées des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA) is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA). All the routes defined as cycle paths in the CCVBA Cycle Master Plan: trails and bike lanes, meeting areas, zones 30… List of fields: Commune Name Prioritization Type of layout Type of road Length Level of achievement The Cycling Master Plan of the Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles can be consulted at the following ... Coverage: Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA). The portal shows the English title as "Bicycle paths of the Community of Communes Vallées des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes Vallée des Baux-Alpilles (CCVBA). Its keywords include transport, deplacement-doux, amenagement-cyclable, mobilite-propre, mobilite, velo. The listing shows 2 download or service links in OGC:WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
